basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of Noe Valley, this fully remodeled home blends timeless SF Victorian charm with thoughtful modern updates. Open concept main floor is perfect for entertaining and everyday living, featuring abundant natural light, great flow, and multiple gathering spaces. The remodeled kitchen features quartz counters and Bosch appliances. Two updated bathrooms plus a newer third bathroom added downstairs. Smart home features include a Nest thermostat and Ring doorbell. Generous storage with California Closets systems. Newer Carrier furnace, ductwork and tankless water heater for comfort and energy efficiency. Outside, enjoy a new roof in 2020 with 25-year warranty, custom front door, updated windows, and fresh paint. The secluded backyard features a hot tub and outdoor shower surrounded by low-maintenance, drought-friendly landscaping. Ideally located near the vibrant Dolores, Guerrero, 24th St and Church St corridors, this prime location offers excellent commuter access to Silicon Valley via 101/280, BART, tech shuttle stops, and Muni two blocks away. Nearby are dozens of popular restaurants, cafes and shops, parks, and Upper Noe Rec Center. A cared-for home that pairs classic SF Victorian charm with modern comforts in an outstanding central location.
